# Jia (家) Framework - AI Cyber Defense & Security Sidecar

> Jia (家) is an open-source, high-performance AI-Native Cyber Defense System combining the Erlang/BEAM OTP actor model (via Gleam) with a high-throughput Rust SecOps engine (Vella). It provides real-time AI prompt injection protection, eBPF kernel syscall inspection, post-quantum cryptography (ML-KEM/ML-DSA), MITRE ATT&CK vector RAG search, and immutable WORM audit logs.

## Core Capabilities
- **Erlang/BEAM OTP Supervision**: Lightweight Gleam actor processes isolate security event streams. Faults automatically self-heal without system downtime.
- **AI Prompt & PII Guardrails**: Filters prompt injection attacks (DAN mode, system prompt overrides) and scrubs PII (SSN, API keys) in real time.
- **eBPF Kernel Syscall Trapper**: Low-level kernel monitoring (`execve`, `ptrace`, `bpf_cmd`) to intercept rootkits and unauthorized memory inspection.
- **Post-Quantum Cryptography Engine**: NIST ML-KEM-768 key encapsulation and ML-DSA-65 signatures over WORM audit logs using SHAKE-256 KMAC.
- **MITRE ATT&CK & CVE RAG Search**: Vector search against Log4Shell, SQLi, ProxyLogon, and Spring4Shell signatures.
- **Dynamic Rhai Security Playbooks**: Real-time evaluation of declarative `.rhai` playbooks for instant SOAR response.
- **Glassmorphic Command Dashboard**: Embedded HTML5/CSS3 real-time dashboard served at `http://127.0.0.1:9090/dashboard`.

## Installation & Usage
```bash
# 1-Line Execution
./start_jia.sh

# Docker Compose
docker compose up -d

# Manual Gleam + Rust Execution
gleam test && gleam run
cd native && cargo run --release
```
